title: Derive an herdr-legal agent slug from the pane id
action: THE LIVE D6 RUN FOUND THIS, and no unit test did. The herdr backend derives the agent slug it passes to `herdr agent start` from the pane id by replacing the colon with a dash (decide_start in packages/bee-rs/crates/fleet/src/backend/herdr.rs). herdr rejects the result for every pane whose id carries an uppercase letter: error code invalid_agent_name, message 'agent name must start with a lowercase letter and contain only lowercase letters, digits, - or _ (1-32 characters)'. herdr numbers panes p1..p9 then pA, pB, pC..., so MOST panes in a busy workspace cannot be started into at all — the whole wave aborts at phase 1 with every target in resolution_failed, which is exactly what a real run over w4:pG and w4:pH did. Fix decide_start so the derived slug is legal by construction: lowercase it, map any character outside [a-z0-9_-] to a dash, ensure it starts with a lowercase letter, and truncate to 32 characters. Keep the slug recognizable in `herdr agent list` output, which is the only reason it is derived from the pane id at all. State the collision this introduces in the function's own doc comment — a lowercased slug cannot distinguish pane ids that differ only by case — and say why that is accepted rather than fixed with a hash. Pin the behavior with a test over decide_start that asserts the argv's NAME argument for an uppercase pane id satisfies herdr's stated rule; assert the RULE, not one hardcoded string, so the test states the contract. Do NOT change is_pane_id_shaped, the Refuse arm, the --kind derivation, or anything in the choreography.

report.outcome: Derived an herdr-legal agent slug (sanitize_agent_slug) so decide_start no longer passes uppercase pane ids like w4:pG straight through to agent start, which herdr 0.8.0 rejects as invalid_agent_name.
deviations: Cell files list named only src/backend/herdr.rs, but the correct slug fix (full lowercase, not colon-only) invalidated one pre-existing hardcoded literal in tests/herdr_backend.rs (a --kind test asserting the full argv string); updated that one line so the declared verify stays green rather than shipping a fix that breaks its own suite.
report.tests: cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml — green — bee test deterministic runner (.bee/logs/test-results.json), 1938 tests passed in fleet+bee lib suite plus all integration/doctest binaries green
